mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_record (user_id, date, type, img, meal_time, content, fullness) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{type}, #{img}, #{mealTime}, #{content}, #{fullness})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meal_record WHERE date = #{date} and user_id = #{userId} and type = #{type}

SELECT meal_record_id, user_id, date, type, img, meal_time, content, fullness FROM meal_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} ORDER BY case WHEN type = '아침' THEN 1 WHEN type = '점심' THEN 2 WHEN type = '저녁' THEN 3 END, meal_record_id;
mapper.update: UPDATE meal_record SET type = #{type}, img = #{img}, meal_time = #{mealTime}, content = #{content} WHERE meal_record_id = #{mealRecordId}
mapper.select: SELECT mr.date, DAYOFYEAR(mr.date) - 1 AS day, COUNT(mr.type) AS countType, br.weight, br.skeletal_muscle, br.body_fat FROM meal_record mr LEFT JOIN body_record br ON mr.date = br.date WHERE mr.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY mr.date, br.weight, br.skeletal_muscle, br.body_fat UNION SELECT br.date, DAYOFYEAR(br.date) - 1 AS day, NULL AS countType, br.weight, br.skeletal_muscle, br.body_fat FROM body_record br LEFT JOIN meal_record mr ON br.date = mr.date WHERE mr.date IS NULL AND br.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY br.date, br.weight, br.skeletal_muscle, br.body_fat
